description: CNA - Cadent Network Areas - Open is a dataset listed in Cadent Gas open data portal, an open data portal of a gas distribution network operator, published or maintained by Cadent Gas Ltd. The gas infrastructure in the UK is broken down into separate networks. Each of these networks covers a region of the UK. This dataset displays each of the networks that Cadent operates in. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Operational, Open. Its keywords are Gas Network Licence, Gas Distribution, Gas Distribution Network, GDN, Gas Distribution Network Areas. The portal shows 2025-08-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence 3.0 (https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-cadent-open-data-portal.
